_about: ING1 rule sets (docs/ING1_INGESTION_AND_STAGE_REGISTRY.md section 3.2). One entry per rule-set id; a rule change is a NEW id committed with its page before any number. status FINAL: a new dataset is processed under it. status OPEN: no rule is claimed, and ingest.py status only lists the records found. artifacts: path templates ({ds} = dataset name, {kb} = name without the stark_ prefix) of the record a stage writes; a dataset with no template for a stage is UNREGISTERED (not 'missing'). Written from the filed pages on 26 Nov 2026; no commit ids are copied from memory.

ingest.rule: the package contract (DATASET.json record, nodes, queries, graph, embeddings manifests, a freeze file); node text as filed for the original datasets, T1 for the STaRK knowledge bases

encode.rule: e3v (D101): gte-modernbert-base and granite-embedding-small-english-r2 fused at 0.5 each, 1,152 wide, float16 unit rows; one arm

first.rule: e3v dense and SPLADE fused by reciprocal rank (C=60), depth 2,500; BM25 and the dense leg are reads

links_layout.rule: families S, R, K; edges deduplicated S > R > K; S never removed; every edge labelled by its rule

links_tightening.rule: none adopted; the base link set stands until the user says the link set is final

pools.rule: no pool rule carried; the records below are the readings filed so far

grade.rule: all golds inside the pool, read at distinct nodes

models.rule: one MLP and one GNN per family; how they use the pools is not settled
